_about: Rift scaling, time limit, wave composition, weekly rotation and rewards. Enemies do not depend on the player: tier N has enemies of level startLevel + (N-1) × levelsPerTier (also past the level cap), with health × baseHp × hpGrowth^(N-1) and damage × baseDamage × damageGrowth^(N-1) — so tiers start easy and keep getting harder without end. minLevel: hero level needed to enter. Every tier has a fixed theme (the zones with a boss, in zone order, repeating) and a fixed enemy line-up. themeBalance: health and damage multiplier per theme, so every theme is about equally hard and tiers climb steadily. Affixes: rifts/affixes/. rewards.repeatXpGold: share of XP and gold paid when a player clears a tier again (0 = XP and gold only on the first clear of each tier; loot and chests always drop).
